skill.summary: Installs and uses Docker reliably with official docs. Use when installing Docker (Desktop or Engine), building or running containers, writing Dockerfiles, us...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added LEARNINGS.md documenting guidance for Docker integration and test environments.
- Clarified behavior when running inside Docker Test: use `docker` directly, avoid install/sudo.
- Added advice on quoting COPY paths with spaces in Dockerfiles.
- Expanded usage examples for running, stopping, removing containers, and compose workflows.
- Added Colima-specific note for macOS under daemon section.
- Added best practices for volume mount paths and referenced LEARNINGS.md for more detail.
